tips.text: Farm the other three resources first, then get both Argon Crystals and start the build the same session; Argon decays and is not refunded.
Use Nekros with Despoil and Khora with Pilfering Strangledome as the loot setup on Survival farms.
Run a Beast companion with Loyal or Resourceful Retriever on every resource run.
Stack a Resource Booster, a Resource Drop Chance Booster and a Relay drop chance Blessing; they multiply together.
Let Nano Spores, Plastids and Rubedo come from normal play; many players already have millions banked.
Nobody frames this as a painful farm; the only common pain is Argon variance and Nano Spores for newer players.
